<div class="review-text">
The book is written in a sort of whiny matter and fails to address some of the best elements of the coming-of-age genre. At the end of the the day, a lot of the negative qualities of the narrator which aren't more obviously addressed left a bad taste in my mouth and didn't fit in to the overall narrative.
